mapper.select: select detail_id, delivery_no, line_no, mat_code, mat_name, spec, quantity, unit_code, del_flag, create_by, create_time from stock_delivery_detail where del_flag = '0' and delivery_no = #{deliveryNo} order by line_no
mapper.insert:
insert into stock_delivery_detail (delivery_no, line_no, mat_code, mat_name, spec, quantity, unit_code, create_by, create_time) values
(#{item.deliveryNo}, #{item.lineNo}, #{item.matCode}, #{item.matName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitCode}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.update: update stock_delivery_detail set del_flag = '1' where delivery_no = #{deliveryNo}
